compiled_state.title: [Inbound Bridge]: parent_id dropped during Jira ingest -> all 71 jira-dig-* tickets are orphans
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0c26228c77e3322b10a488eb32ef037ca16a127c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Inbound bridge should preserve Jira parent/epic-link relationships when creating local mirror tickets, so the local hierarchy reflects the Jira hierarchy.

#### Actual Behavior

100% of jira-dig-* tickets (71/71) have null or empty parent_id in the local tracker. Zero tickets in the tracker reference any jira-dig-* ticket as their parent.

### 6. Logs

```
.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --format=llm | jq '[.[] | select(.id|startswith("jira-dig-")) | select(.parent_id==null or .parent_id=="")] | length'
71
```
